skill.name: pathml
skill.description: Computational pathology toolkit for analyzing whole-slide images (WSI) and multiparametric imaging data. Use this skill when working with histopathology slides, H&E stained images, multiplex immunofluorescence (CODEX, Vectra), spatial proteomics, nucleus detection/segmentation, tissue graph construction, or training ML models on pathology data. Supports 160+ slide formats including Aperio SVS, NDPI, DICOM, OME-TIFF for digital pathology workflows.
skill.summary: Guide PathML workflows for whole-slide imaging, spatial pathology, machine learning, and multiplex image analysis.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are documentation syntax or standard local PathML operations, not executable threats. Remote DeepCell inference creates a real data-disclosure boundary, while unpinned installation and unrestricted checkpoint loading require safeguards.

remediation.issue: Remote segmentation can disclose sensitive pathology images.
remediation.suggestion: Make remote inference opt-in and document transmitted data, deidentification, consent, retention, authentication, and a local SegmentMIF alternative.

remediation.issue: The quick start installs unpinned packages and all optional dependencies.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed version constraint or lockfile, verify package integrity, and require user confirmation before installing dependencies.

remediation.issue: The feature example loads a checkpoint through unrestricted torch.load.
remediation.suggestion: Use weights_only=True where supported, load a state dictionary into a known architecture, and verify the checkpoint source and hash.

content.value_statement: Whole-slide workflows involve complex formats, preprocessing choices, and large datasets. This skill provides focused PathML guidance for reproducible pathology analysis.
actual_capabilities: Load whole-slide images and explain pyramid levels, regions, tiles, and supported formats.
Design PathML pipelines for tissue detection, stain normalization, segmentation, and quality control.
Construct cell and tissue graphs for spatial feature analysis.
Plan HoVer-Net, HACTNet, PyTorch, and ONNX training or inference workflows.
Organize pathology tiles, masks, metadata, and features with HDF5 and memory mapping.
Process CODEX, Vectra, and MERFISH data for segmentation and marker quantification.
limitations: Provides guidance and examples but does not execute PathML workflows independently.
Requires local PathML, compatible image libraries, and sufficient storage or compute resources.
Model outputs require expert validation and are not clinical diagnoses.
Remote segmentation can transmit image data to an external API and requires privacy review.

use_cases.title: Build a WSI preprocessing pipeline
use_cases.description: Configure tiling, tissue detection, stain normalization, and HDF5 output for a pathology dataset.

use_cases.title: Prepare spatial graph analysis
use_cases.description: Convert segmented cells into feature-rich graphs for neighborhood analysis or graph neural networks.

use_cases.title: Analyze multiplex imaging data
use_cases.description: Plan CODEX or Vectra segmentation, marker quantification, AnnData export, and batch processing.

prompt_templates.title: Explain PathML basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how PathML loads a {slide_format} image. Compare pyramid levels, tiles, and regions for a beginner.
prompt_templates.scenario: Learn the main image-loading concepts before building a workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Design a preprocessing pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a PathML pipeline for {stain_type} slides using {tile_size}-pixel tiles. Include quality control, normalization, segmentation, and output storage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a reproducible plan for a new slide cohort.

prompt_templates.title: Plan multiplex analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a PathML workflow for {platform} data with {nuclear_channel} and {membrane_channel}. Include segmentation, marker quantification, AnnData export, and privacy safeguards.
prompt_templates.scenario: Analyze spatial proteomics images locally or through approved remote inference.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize model training
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and evaluate a {model_name} workflow for {task}. Address data splits, augmentation, metrics, checkpoints, ONNX deployment, and compute constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an advanced pathology model for reproducible evaluation and deployment.

output_examples.input: Create a preprocessing plan for H&E whole-slide images.
output: Load each slide at a suitable pyramid level and generate overlapping tiles.
Detect tissue, normalize stain appearance, label artifacts, and preserve masks.
Store tiles, masks, metadata, and provenance in HDF5 for reproducible processing.
Collapse imaging runs and identify validated nuclear and membrane channels.
Segment cells locally with Mesmer, then quantify markers for each cell.
Export measurements and spatial coordinates to AnnData for downstream analysis.

output_examples.input: Recommend an evaluation plan for HoVer-Net.
output: Split data by patient before training to prevent information leakage.
Measure Dice, aggregated Jaccard, and panoptic quality on held-out slides.
Review errors by tissue type and confirm performance with pathology experts.

best_practices: Inspect slide metadata and pyramid dimensions before selecting tile size, stride, and level.
Keep raw slides immutable, record preprocessing parameters, and validate outputs on representative tissue.
Deidentify clinical images and review data policies before using remote inference services.
anti_patterns: Do not process every slide at full resolution without estimating memory, storage, and runtime.
Do not evaluate pathology models with training data or omit patient-level data separation.
Do not send identifiable images to external APIs without authorization and documented safeguards.

faq.question: Does this skill run PathML?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and examples. Execution requires a configured Python environment with PathML and its dependencies.

faq.question: Which slide formats are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers PathML-supported formats, including SVS, NDPI, DICOM, OME-TIFF, and common multiparametric imaging formats.

faq.question: Can this skill diagnose disease?
faq.answer: No. Its workflows support research analysis, and qualified experts must validate results before any clinical use.

faq.question: Does it support multiplex imaging?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers CODEX, Vectra, MERFISH, Mesmer segmentation, marker quantification, and AnnData export.

faq.question: How are very large slides handled?
faq.answer: PathML uses image pyramids, regions, tiles, HDF5 storage, and memory mapping to control resource use.

faq.question: Does remote segmentation keep data local?
faq.answer: No. Remote inference sends image data to an external service, so authorization, deidentification, and retention controls are required.
